title: Finite Q3 energy-weighted mixed force-momentum estimate and truncated-CCR boundary
question: On the actual finite two-site Q3 oscillator regularization, can the unweighted mixed force-momentum bound be replaced by a two-sided A^(-3/4) energy-weighted factorization, and does the finite data establish a cutoff-uniform weighted constant?

model.tail: W_L=B-B_L for the declared cosine spectral coordinate cutoff
model.energy_weight: A=I+H-min(spec(H))*I, so A is finite positive and A^(-3/4) is defined spectrally
model.ideal_bound: When R_L=0, the corrected bound reduces to the two-sided energy-weighted modular-domain estimate proposed for the Q3 core.

scaling_boundary.diagnostic: At fixed radius L=1, the finite global-weight constants u_E and v_E are recorded across n=4,6,8,10,12.
scaling_boundary.meaning: The global shifted-H weight improves the finite bound but is not a local, volume-uniform modular estimate by itself.
scaling_boundary.not_claimed: Finite growth or improvement is not an asymptotic theorem and neither proves nor refutes a local energy-weighted Q3 bound.

adversarial_review.check: The right leg is factored through A^(-3/4) and A^(3/4) without assuming that A commutes with M, p or rho.
The finite oscillator does not satisfy exact CCR; the residual R_L is retained in the corrected bound rather than silently set to zero.
Mdot_L is differentiated in the joint commuting coordinate basis and is kept distinct from the finite commutator derivative.
Both Gibbs seminorm legs are included, with K_+ and K_0 computed from the same full-H Gibbs state.
A=I+H-min(H)I has spectrum at least one, so all fractional powers are finite and unambiguous.
The finite dimensions are a diagnostic only; no cutoff, volume, source or beta uniformity is inferred.
The second script reconstructs the oscillator, Q3 matrices, Gibbs state, coordinate derivative and weighted constants without importing the primary lane.
R264 checks the rational corrected/ideal bound algebra and scope firewall only; it does not formalize matrix spectral calculus or QFT limits.
Direct D and delta-D Cauchy, modular-domain transfer, history, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: A finite actual-Q3 corrected energy-weighted mixed force-momentum estimate with explicit finite-CCR residual, plus the ideal residual-free formula as a named modular-domain target.
qft_interface.open: A local energy/modular weight with source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform constants, residual/domain transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, history, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite QFT-facing energy-weighted mixed estimate. The corrected finite bound does not close the ideal modular-domain or thermodynamic route.
next_action: Prove a local source- and volume-uniform bound for u_E, v_E and the finite-CCR/domain residual on the actual Q3 common core, or construct a genuine scaling obstruction before using the ideal formula in the direct D,delta-D history gate.
no_overclaim: This package is not an ideal residual-free Q3 core theorem, an all-time projected D/delta-D theorem, an OS reconstruction, a KMS/GNS result, a mass-gap proof, a continuum result, a C6/Sector-A/Pre-A result, a TECT production map or a Clay result.
